page.layout: One blank exterior cover: a limp vellum binding seen flat, with five sewing supports on the left edge and a narrow spine label at the far left. No printed text on the cover itself.
page.notes: The cover is a blank vellum binding, not a printed leaf. The spine label at the far left edge shows only faint marks and possible handwriting, none of it legible, so nothing is transcribed. Stains, creases and wear on the vellum are not printed text.
